title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - CT-7801
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: CT-7801 (COOLING TOWER CELL FAN).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-7801, Title: P&ID: COOLING TOWER FAN (CT-7801) SYSTEM.
Area: 7800 – Cooling Water System, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-7800-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- VSHH-7802: Fan/gearbox vibration HIGH-HIGH (Vibration Switch) [Setpoint: > 9 mm/s]. Function: Cause T1 (Trip Fan Motor CT-7801). Location: Fan Drive Shaft / Gearbox. Interlock: T1/EFF-1/EFF-2/EFF-3
- TSHH-7803: Gearbox oil temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temp Switch) [Setpoint: > 90 degC]. Function: Cause T2 (Trip Fan Motor CT-7801). Location: Fan Gearbox. Interlock: T2/EFF-1/EFF-2/EFF-3
- PSL-7807: Gearbox oil pressure LOW (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 0.8 barg]. Function: Cause T3 (Trip Fan Motor CT-7801). Location: Gearbox lube oil system. Interlock: T3/EFF-1/EFF-2
- MPR-7801: Fan motor overload relay (Motor Protection) [Setpoint: MPR pickup —]. Function: Cause T4 (Trip Fan Motor CT-7801). Location: Motor MCC Panel. Interlock: T4/EFF-1/EFF-2/EFF-3
- LG gearbox: Gearbox oil sight glass / level gauge (Level Gauge). Function: Permissive P1 (LG Gearbox oil level OK). Location: Fan Gearbox. Interlock: P1
- LT-7804: Basin level transmitter (Level Transmitter) [Setpoint: > LSL-7804 —]. Function: Permissive P2 (Basin level normal). Location: Cooling Tower Basin. Interlock: P2
- Lockout Key: Maintenance lockout switch (Hand Switch). Function: Permissive P3 (Lockout release logic). Location: Motor MCC / Field. Interlock: P3
- AI-7805: Circulating Water pH Analyzer (Analyzer (pH)) [Setpoint: 7.0-8.5 pH]. Function: Monitoring & Dosing Control (dari OPL). Location: Cooling water return line. Interlock: —
- AI-7806: Conductivity Analyzer (Analyzer (Cond)). Function: Blowdown Control (dari OPL). Location: Cooling water basin/return. Interlock: —
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-CT-7801, Interlock: SEQ-7801.
